== Summary ==
Full-card remaster of [[Allegations Of Corruption (V) (Virtual Set: Defensive Shields)|Allegations Of Corruption (V)]] (slip 09 of [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]]): the Players Committee's slip set onto the printed Decipher card, re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's Holotable cards. Fan reconstruction made with the SWCCG card maker (billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), 2026; not a Committee product.

Sources: slip from [https://web.archive.org/web/20071028141121/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/DefensiveShields.pdf DefensiveShields.pdf] (Players Committee sheet, Internet Archive 28 October 2007), official text as of 4 December 2006; top half, lore and art from the printed Decipher card.
